snapshot_read_permission.title: UniFi Drive snapshot targets cannot be read
snapshot_read_permission.description:
Snapshot controls are enabled for `{entry_title}`, but the configured account or API key cannot read Drive snapshot settings.

UniFi response: `{error}`

Grant the account Drive snapshot permissions, update the integration credentials, or disable snapshot controls.

snapshot_read_unavailable.title: UniFi Drive snapshot targets are unavailable
snapshot_read_unavailable.description:
Snapshot controls are enabled for `{entry_title}`, but the local Drive snapshot settings endpoint is not available or returned an unsupported response.

This may be normal on this firmware or for this account. Storage monitoring is not affected.

UniFi response: `{error}`

Update UniFi Drive, check whether this system supports snapshots, or disable snapshot controls.

snapshot_create_permission.title: UniFi Drive snapshots cannot be created
snapshot_create_permission.description:
Home Assistant could not create snapshots for `{target_name}` on `{entry_title}` because the configured account or API key lacks permission.

UniFi response: `{error}`

Grant Drive snapshot create permissions or update the integration credentials.

snapshot_create_unavailable.title: UniFi Drive snapshot creation is unavailable
snapshot_create_unavailable.description:
Home Assistant could not create snapshots for `{target_name}` on `{entry_title}` because the local Drive endpoint for `{target_type}` targets is unavailable or unsupported.

This may be normal on this firmware or for this account. Storage monitoring is not affected.

UniFi response: `{error}`

Update UniFi Drive, check whether this target type supports manual snapshot creation, or avoid automations that call snapshot creation for this target.

snapshot_settings_permission.title: UniFi Drive snapshot settings cannot be changed
snapshot_settings_permission.description:
Home Assistant could not change snapshot settings for `{target_name}` on `{entry_title}` because the configured account or API key lacks permission.

UniFi response: `{error}`

Grant Drive snapshot settings permissions or update the integration credentials.

snapshot_settings_unavailable.title: UniFi Drive snapshot settings are unavailable
snapshot_settings_unavailable.description:
Home Assistant could not change snapshot settings for `{target_name}` on `{entry_title}` because the local Drive endpoint for `{target_type}` targets is unavailable or unsupported.

This may be normal on this firmware or for this account. Storage monitoring is not affected.

UniFi response: `{error}`

Update UniFi Drive, check whether this target type supports snapshot settings writes, or avoid automations that change snapshot settings for this target.

snapshot_target_missing.title: UniFi Drive snapshot target is missing
snapshot_target_missing.description:
Home Assistant still has snapshot controls for `{target_name}` on `{entry_title}`, but UniFi Drive has not exposed this `{target_type}` target for {missing_count} consecutive refreshes.

The entities are kept unavailable instead of being deleted automatically. This may be normal on this firmware or for this account. Storage monitoring is not affected.

Check the Drive snapshot targets and account permissions. If the target returns, this repair will clear automatically.

user.title: Set up UniFi Drive / UNAS
user.description: Connect to the local UniFi Drive API. Select a discovered device or enter the host manually. Use either username/password or an API key. If both are provided, username/password is used.

data_description.host: IP address, DNS name, host:port, or HTTPS URL of the local UniFi Drive / UNAS device.
data_description.port: Local API port. HTTPS devices normally use 443.
data_description.ssl: Use HTTPS for the local UniFi API connection.
data_description.verify_ssl: Validate the device certificate. Disable this for self-signed local certificates.
data_description.username: Local UniFi OS username used for session authentication.
data_description.password: Password for the local UniFi OS user. Leave empty during reconfigure to keep the saved password.
data_description.api_key: Optional UniFi API key. Used only when username or password is empty.
data_description.scan_interval: Polling interval for local API reads. The allowed range is 30 to 3600 seconds.
data_description.fan_control_enabled: Create the fan-mode select when the device exposes fan-control endpoints.
data_description.snapshot_buttons_enabled: Create snapshot controls after reading Drive snapshot targets. Disabled by default because it uses optional local Drive endpoints.
data_description.discovery_debug: Add extra debug information for discovery identity matching and expose the state in diagnostics.
data_description.wol_enabled: Create a Wake-on-LAN start button when a MAC address is configured.
data_description.wol_broadcast_address: IPv4 broadcast address for the target network. Use 255.255.255.255 when unsure.
data_description.wol_port: UDP port used for the Wake-on-LAN magic packet. Most devices use 9.
data_description.wol_mac_address: MAC address used for Wake-on-LAN and trusted discovery identity matching.
